about.description: Brix Money is a tokenized emerging-market assets protocol on MegaETH (Ethereum L2 with sub-10ms blocks). Founded by Alp Ergin (CEO). Backed by $5.5M seed round (April 2026) led by Yapı Kredi's FRWRD venture arm and Iş Asset Management (Iş Bankası) - major Turkish financial institutions - alongside Circle Ventures, ConsenSys, and Borderless Capital. Selected for MegaETH's "MegaMafia" accelerator program (batch 2). Launched flagship product iTRY (Turkish Lira-pegged stablecoin) on April 20, 2026 alongside wiTRY (yield-bearing wrapper). Brix's structural innovation is partnering with local financial institutions to originate and manage underlying assets, while Brix handles distribution and on-chain composability. Future roadmap targets UAE, Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, South Korea. The Turkish Lira yield product brings ~40% annualized central-bank policy rates onchain via a BVI-regulated money market fund + RedStone 24/7 FX oracle.
about.registryInfo: Brix is a tokenized emerging-markets assets protocol building on MegaETH (Ethereum L2). Co-founder & CEO: Alp Ergin. Closed $5.5M seed round in April 2026; investors include Yapı Kredi (FRWRD venture arm), Iş Asset Management (Iş Bankası), Circle Ventures, ConsenSys, and Borderless Capital. Selected for MegaMafia accelerator (2nd batch). Underlying iTRY backing is held in a BVI-regulated fund investing in Turkish money market instruments; oracle is RedStone (24/7 FX-adjusted feed solving the Turkish Lira off-hours dilemma). Future products target the UAE, Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, and South Korea emerging-market currencies.

fees.revenueNotes: Brix retains a portion of the underlying Turkish money market fund yield as the spread between iTRY rebase rate and wiTRY accrual. Specific bps not publicly disclosed. ~40% annualized Turkish central bank policy rate is the source. Source: https://brix.money/itry
